verdict.rationale: Swapping LLM providers is a fair question for an agent orchestration framework, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of a model-agnostic interface, provider integrations, or configurable model selection. Community notes that nodes are 'just functions that can do whatever you want' (langgraph-comm-7) describe a building block a developer could use to construct provider swapping, not a documented swap capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can swap the underlying LLM provider or model without rewriting my agent
